about: Real things shown through a print effect, alive under the pointer: four take the client's own photographs (src), one models a generic thing in code. The one moment of a software, tech, AI or games page, on one card or one hero frame; never on a place, service, product or local-business page (those show their photographs plain, a product its object render); never animated on scroll. Contract: _scenes/README.md.
load: assets/objects/_scenes/auto.js (mounts every [data-scene]); or import <id>/object.js and call mount(el, { src, params, palette }).
lint: node assets/objects/_scenes/lint-glsl.mjs (every scene shader against the rules of GLSL ES 1.00 and 3.00; kit.js runs the same check before every compile).

objects.name: Split reveal
objects.line: One photograph, half printed as a halftone; the line follows the pointer.
objects.for: In the kit's gallery only, never on a page (references/effects-objects.md): no page prints, dithers or grades a photograph. What it was made for: a feature card or a wide frame: a real photograph of what the product works on (a photo or design app's picture, the device a tech company makes, a game's key art).

objects.name: Dither sequence
objects.line: Two to six photographs that belong together, dithered and cut one to the next; the pointer scrubs.
objects.for: In the kit's gallery only, never on a page (references/effects-objects.md): no page prints, dithers or grades a photograph. What it was made for: two to six real photographs that belong together (a device from several sides, the stages of what the software makes, a game's scenes), never a random set.

objects.name: Dot object
objects.line: An object cut out of its photograph and set in dots; under the pointer the dots show its real colour.
objects.src: one object shot on a seamless plain ground, or a cut-out PNG
objects.for: In the kit's gallery only, never on a page (references/effects-objects.md): no page prints, dithers or grades a photograph. What it was made for: a feature card about a real thing the product works with: a device the app runs or controls, the hardware a developer tool ships to, a product photographed for a shop builder or a photo app. Only with a plain-ground shot or a cut-out PNG; a busy or sunlit background does not cut out.

objects.name: Exploded layers
objects.line: A photograph as four printed sheets; hover opens them, with the client's names on leader lines.
objects.src: one photograph, or up to four (one per sheet)
objects.for: Software that works in layers or passes: imaging, design and print tools, maps, documents.

objects.name: Product turntable
objects.line: A generic camera, chair, speaker or cup, stepping round on a turntable.
objects.for: A feature card about a kind of thing the product handles (cameras in a rental platform, a chair in a furniture marketplace). Never the client's own product.
